verses.text: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

segments.text: Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

verses.text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me: They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.

segments.text: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit have they opened against me:
They have spoken unto me with a lying tongue.

verses.text: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred, And fought against me without a cause.

segments.text: They have compassed me about also with words of hatred,
And fought against me without a cause.

verses.text: For my love they are my adversaries: But I give myself unto prayer.

segments.text: For my love they are my adversaries:
But I
give myself unto
prayer.

verses.text: And they have rewarded me evil for good, And hatred for my love.

segments.text: And they have rewarded me evil for good,
And hatred for my love.

verses.text: Set thou a wicked man over him; And let an adversary stand at his right hand.

segments.text: Set thou a wicked man over him;
And let an adversary stand at his right hand.

verses.text: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty; And let his prayer be turned into sin.

segments.text: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty;
And let his prayer be turned into sin.

verses.text: Let his days be few; And let another take his office.

segments.text: Let his days be few;
And
let another take his office.

verses.text: Let his children be fatherless, And his wife a widow.

segments.text: Let his children be fatherless,
And his wife a widow.

verses.text: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg; And let them seek their bread out of their desolate places.

segments.text: Let his children be vagabonds, and beg;
And let them seek
their bread
out of their desolate places.

verses.text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; And let strangers make spoil of his labor.

segments.text: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath;
And let strangers make spoil of his labor.

verses.text: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him; Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.

segments.text: Let there be none to extend kindness unto him;
Neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.

verses.text: Let his posterity be cut off; In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

segments.text: Let his posterity be cut off;
In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

verses.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah; And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

segments.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with Jehovah;
And let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

verses.text: Let them be before Jehovah continually, That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;

segments.text: Let them be before Jehovah continually,
That he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;

verses.text: Because he remembered not to show kindness, But persecuted the poor and needy man, And the broken in heart, to slay them.

segments.text: Because he remembered not to show kindness,
But persecuted the poor and needy man,
And the broken in heart, to slay
them

verses.text: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him; And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

segments.text: Yea, he loved cursing, and it came unto him;
And he delighted not in blessing, and it was far from him.

verses.text: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment, And it came into his inward parts like water, And like oil into his bones.

segments.text: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment,
And it came into his inward parts like water,
And like oil into his bones.

verses.text: Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself, And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

segments.text: Let it be unto him as the raiment wherewith he covereth himself,
And for the girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

verses.text: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah, And of them that speak evil against my soul.

segments.text: This is the reward of mine adversaries from Jehovah,
And of them that speak evil against my soul.

verses.text: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name’s sake: Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;

segments.text: But deal thou with me, O Jehovah the Lord, for thy name’s sake:
Because thy lovingkindness is good, deliver thou me;

verses.text: For I am poor and needy, And my heart is wounded within me.

segments.text: For I am poor and needy,
And my heart is wounded within me.

verses.text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

segments.text: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth:
I am tossed up and down as the locust.

verses.text: My knees are weak through fasting; And my flesh faileth of fatness.

segments.text: My knees are weak through fasting;
And my flesh faileth of fatness.

verses.text: I am become also a reproach unto them: When they see me, they shake their head.

segments.text: I am become also a reproach unto them:
When they see me, they shake their head.

verses.text: Help me, O Jehovah my God; Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:

segments.text: Help me, O Jehovah my God;
Oh save me according to thy lovingkindness:

verses.text: That they may know that this is thy hand; That thou, Jehovah, hast done it.

segments.text: That they may know that this is thy hand;
That
thou, Jehovah, hast done it.

verses.text: Let them curse, but bless thou: When they arise, they shall be put to shame, But thy servant shall rejoice.

segments.text: Let them curse, but bless thou:
When they arise, they shall be put to shame,
But thy servant shall rejoice.

verses.text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor, And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

segments.text: Let mine adversaries be clothed with dishonor,
And let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

verses.text: I will give great thanks unto Jehovah with my mouth; Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

segments.text: I will give great thanks unto Jehovah with my mouth;
Yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

verses.text: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, To save him from them that judge his soul.

segments.text: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy,
To save him from them that judge his soul.

headings.text: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David.
